title: Age, gender, and locality effects on innovation in the Twi vowel harmony system
annotation_target: target vowel intervals; F1/F2 midpoint; duration
manual_scope: target vowels manually annotated before scripted acoustic measurement
decision_reason: Primary elicited production data with explicitly manual target-vowel annotation.
evidence_summary: Paper states target vowels were manually annotated; duration and F1/F2 were then measured in Praat.

title: SwehVd Central Swedish hVd vowel database
annotation_target: word/vowel boundaries; F0; F1-F3 trajectories; duration
manual_scope: forced-alignment estimates; vowel boundaries manually corrected by first author for all relevant tokens
decision_reason: Primary recordings; relevant segment boundaries were manually corrected exhaustively.
evidence_summary: Methods state SweFA estimated boundaries and the first author manually corrected them using spectrograms, waveforms, pitch and intensity.

title: Chulalongkorn Corpus of Spoken Thai (CCOST)
task: spontaneous interview; word list; sentence reading
manual_scope: ASR/forced alignment followed by manual correction by phonetically trained native Thai annotators
decision_reason: Primary corpus with phone-level human-corrected annotations and audio/TextGrids.
evidence_summary: Corpus paper states ASR/MAUS output was manually corrected by phonetically trained native Thai speakers.

title: PAVOQUE Corpus of Expressive Speech
task: read speech in neutral and expressive styles
token_or_recording_size: thousands of utterances; 3,000 neutral sentences plus expressive subsets
manual_scope: phone-level labels/segment boundaries manually checked and corrected where needed
decision_reason: Primary recordings with manually corrected phone segmentation.
evidence_summary: Repository and corpus paper describe phone-level segmentation as manually corrected/checked.

title: Ohio State Stories Corpus
task: 30 short stories, plain and clear styles
token_or_recording_size: 2,700 story recordings; 236 target words per story design
manual_scope: every target-vowel onset and offset hand-corrected after forced alignment
decision_reason: Original corpus; all relevant target-vowel boundaries hand-corrected.
evidence_summary: Corpus documentation says entire corpus was forced aligned and onset/offset of each target vowel hand-corrected.

title: Underpinnings of explicit phonetic imitation: perception, production, and variability
annotation_target: stop burst; onset of periodicity; vowel offset; derived VOT/vowel duration
manual_scope: three acoustic landmarks manually annotated for target words
decision_reason: Primary experiment and manual landmarks; raw audio/annotation-file availability still needs file-level check.
evidence_summary: Methods specify manual annotation of burst, periodicity onset, and vowel end for target initial voiceless stops.

manual_scope: automatic duration boundaries were hand-corrected in Praat
decision_reason: Primary experiment with hand-corrected segmentation; repository file contents still need harvesting.
evidence_summary: Paper states segment durations were automatically determined and then hand-corrected in Praat; data/analyses on OSF.

title: Jingju a Cappella Recordings Collection — primary-recording subset
manual_scope: segmentation done manually in Praat; retain only newly recorded/consented primary subset
license: Creative Commons; exact source-specific license in record
decision_reason: Manual phoneme segmentation is valuable, but collection mixes newly recorded and pre-existing commercial material; only primary recordings qualify.
evidence_summary: Zenodo record states manual Praat segmentation and identifies newly created recordings separately from commercial recordings.

title: MRPL2 Non-native Speech Corpus
manual_scope: utterances manually annotated for phonetic mispronunciations
decision_reason: Strong manual annotation provenance, but files are restricted and primary-collection details need full-paper verification.
evidence_summary: Zenodo record describes 4,500 utterances and manual phonetic mispronunciation annotation; files restricted.

title: Mixed language processing increases cross-language phonetic transfer in Bengali–English bilinguals
task: cued picture naming and controlled code-switching
manual_scope: recordings manually segmented and annotated in Praat
decision_reason: Primary elicited bilingual production with explicitly manual segmentation and open token-level data/analysis files.
evidence_summary: Methods report 10 participants × 20 target words × 2 conditions × 2 tasks × 4 repetitions = 3200 tokens; recordings manually segmented and annotated in Praat; OSF provides materials, data files, and analysis code.

title: Selective tuning of nasal coarticulation and hyperarticulation across slow-clear, casual, and fast-clear speech styles
task: carrier-sentence reading in slow-clear, casual, and fast-clear styles
annotation_target: target vowel boundaries; F1-F3 trajectories; A1-P0 nasalization; speech rate
manual_scope: each utterance reviewed by trained RAs; target vowel boundaries hand-corrected after MFA using formant structure, voicing bar, and amplitude
decision_reason: Primary home-recorded production; every analyzed target-vowel interval has human-corrected boundaries and OSF supports the reported measurements.
evidence_summary: Paper reports trained-RA annotation of all 2698 utterances, removal of problematic trials, MFA followed by hand-correction of target vowel boundaries, and five retained time-normalized formant/nasality measurement windows.

title: L2-ARCTIC manually annotated subset
token_or_recording_size: 3599 manually examined utterances within 26,867 total utterances
manual_scope: selected ~150 utterances per speaker manually examined with corrected word and phone boundaries and error tags
decision_reason: Primary L2 recordings; only the explicitly manually examined 3,599-utterance subset qualifies, not the remaining forced-aligned corpus.
evidence_summary: Corpus documentation reports 24 speakers, 27.1 hours overall, and human annotators manually examined 3,599 utterances with 14,098 substitutions, 3,420 deletions, and 1,092 additions; the manual subset includes corrected word and phone boundaries.
